moves.text: Offer jsous: George Pickens + C.J. Stroud for Josh Allen.

reasons: You're 6-1 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 12%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 5th of 11 contenders (144.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is QB (7th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 5th in 2026, 3rd in 2027 and 4th in 2028 (title chances about 12%, 16%, 14%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.

That trade raises your title chance from 12% to 18%, and your lineup comes out 5.2 points a week ahead overall. George Pickens + C.J. Stroud add 13.3 points a week for you today, but Josh Allen is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 11,402, get 9,999), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.1 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 16% and 14% to 18% and 16%.
You have 6 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 8 is your weakest projected week (137 points vs your usual 155), mostly byes.
Mike Gesicki may be worth more now than later: age 31: TE values usually drop after this season.
